jars: 'the roles have shifted' - sounds like a corporate HR memo, not a human feeling
'false affection' - sounds like I'm being accused of being fake with my own son
'greet your mother with your full attention, even if she cannot answer' - sounds like a chore, not comfort
'the love that has nowhere to go' - sounds like a sci-fi movie, not my life
best: Tonight, sit in the quiet of the empty house. Let the love that has nowhere to go simply rest in the stillness.
day1_verdict: The moon holding my son like a father actually made me cry, because it finally put words to the ache of the 4-hour drive.
